summary.text: Garrett Sheeks is the Libertarian candidate for the Arkansas House of Representatives, District 61, in the November 3, 2026 general election, where the Republican incumbent is Jeremiah Moore; he ran for the same seat in 2022 and 2024.

paragraphs.text: Garrett Sheeks advanced from the Libertarian Party convention on February 22, 2026.
He ran for Arkansas House District 61 in the 2022 general election, receiving 2.5 percent of the vote in a race won by Jeremiah Moore.
In 2024 he ran again and received 22.2 percent of the vote against incumbent Jeremiah Moore.
